output.reason: [ev-b27c9d0a38d7] lists this under the CLI changelog as a fix to the `flux events` command honouring `--all-namespaces`. That makes it a client-side invocation, not a container argument of Flux's in-cluster workloads. A cli-flag leaf (as in P1 and P3) would therefore check the wrong thing. No static environment input shows whether operators run `flux events --all-namespaces`, so undecidable with environment-visibility-gap is the correct exposure condition.
